tool_schemas.name: get_current_scene_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns information about the currently open Unity Editor scene; when detailLevel is RootObjectsOnly it returns only root GameObjects, and when FullHierarchy it returns the complete transform hierarchy. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if there is no active Unity Editor connection, NOT_FOUND if no scene is loaded/available to query, and VALIDATION_ERROR if detailLevel is not one of the supported enum values. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the editor fails while resolving the scene snapshot.

detailLevel.description: RootObjectsOnly: Returns just root GameObjects. FullHierarchy: Returns complete hierarchy with all children.

tool_schemas.name: get_game_objects_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of GameObject records for the requested instanceIDs from the current scene, with optional inclusion of components and/or child hierarchies based on detailLevel; results are returned in the same order as the provided instanceIDs and are not paged. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if there is no active Unity Editor connection and NOT_FOUND if any requested instanceID does not exist in the current scene snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instanceIDs is empty, contains non-numeric values, or detailLevel is not one of the supported enum values.

instanceIDs.description: Array of GameObject instance IDs to get information for

detailLevel.description: BasicInfo: Basic GameObject information. IncludeComponents: Includes component details. IncludeChildren: Includes child GameObjects. IncludeComponentsAndChildren: Includes both components and a full hierarchy with components on children.

tool_schemas.name: execute_editor_command
tool_schemas.description: Compiles and executes the provided C# code in the connected Unity Editor and returns the value produced by McpScript.Execute(), recording the invocation in the audit trail; this operation is not paged. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if there is no active Unity Editor connection and VALIDATION_ERROR if code is empty or does not define a public class McpScript with a public static Execute() method that returns a value. Raises EXECUTION_ERROR when compilation fails or the executed code throws at runtime, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if server-side execution limits are exceeded.

code.description: C# code to execute in Unity Editor. You MUST define a public class named "McpScript" with a public static method named "Execute" that returns an object. Example: "public class McpScript { public static object Execute() { /* your code here */ return result; } }". You can include any necessary namespaces, additional classes, and methods.

tool_schemas.name: get_logs
tool_schemas.description: Returns Unity Editor log entries matching the provided filters (types, message/stack trace substring, timestamp bounds) and includes only the requested fields; the result is limited by count (max 1000) and is not paged. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if there is no active Unity Editor connection and VALIDATION_ERROR if count is out of range, types/fields contain unsupported values, or timestampAfter/timestampBefore are not valid ISO timestamps or form an invalid range. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the log stream cannot be read from the editor.

count.description: Maximum number of log entries to return

fields.description: Specify which fields to include in the output

stackTraceContains.description: Filter logs by stack trace content

timestampAfter.description: Filter logs after this ISO timestamp

timestampBefore.description: Filter logs before this ISO timestamp

tool_schemas.name: verify_connection
tool_schemas.description: Checks whether the MCP server currently has an active Unity Editor connection and returns connection status metadata; this operation is not paged. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to query connection status. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the connection registry cannot be accessed.

tool_schemas.name: get_editor_state
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current Unity Editor state snapshot, including project identification and the active connection context; this operation is not paged. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if there is no active Unity Editor connection. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the editor state cannot be retrieved.

tool_schemas.name: read_file
tool_schemas.description: Reads and returns the full contents of the file at path, resolved relative to the Unity project’s Assets folder when a relative path is provided; this operation is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if path is empty or not a valid path string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read project files, and NOT_FOUND if the resolved file does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the resolved path is outside the allowed Assets scope and INTERNAL_ERROR if the file cannot be read.

path.description: Path to the file to read. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder.

tool_schemas.name: read_multiple_files
tool_schemas.description: Reads and returns the contents for each requested path in a single call (one result per input path, in the same order) with paths resolved relative to the Unity project’s Assets folder when relative; this operation is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if paths is missing/empty or contains invalid path values, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read project files, and NOT_FOUND if any resolved file does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if any resolved path is outside the allowed Assets scope and INTERNAL_ERROR if any file cannot be read.

paths.description: Array of file paths to read. Paths can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder.

tool_schemas.name: write_file
tool_schemas.description: Creates or overwrites the file at path with the provided content and returns write metadata for auditing; paths are resolved relative to the Unity project’s Assets folder when relative and this operation is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if path is invalid or content is missing, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to mutate project files, and FORBIDDEN if the resolved path is outside the allowed Assets scope. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR if the write fails.

path.description: Path to the file to write. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder.

content.description: Content to write to the file

tool_schemas.name: edit_file
tool_schemas.description: Applies an ordered set of exact text replacements to the file at path and returns a git-style diff (or, when dryRun is true, returns the diff without persisting changes); this operation is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if edits is empty, any edit is missing oldText/newText, or an oldText does not match exactly in the current file contents, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to mutate project files, and NOT_FOUND if the resolved file does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the resolved path is outside the allowed Assets scope and INTERNAL_ERROR if the file cannot be read or updated.

path.description: Path to the file to edit. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder.

oldText.description: Text to search for - must match exactly

edits.description: Array of edit operations to apply

dryRun.description: Preview changes using git-style diff format

tool_schemas.name: list_directory
tool_schemas.description: Lists the immediate children (files and directories) of the given directory path and returns their names and basic type information; if `path` is empty, we list the project’s `Assets` root, and relative paths are resolved under `Assets`. This endpoint is not paged and returns the full directory listing in a single response. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `path` is not a string or is malformed, `NOT_FOUND` when the path does not exist, and `CONFLICT` when the path exists but is not a directory.

path.description: Path to the directory to list. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder. Example: "Scenes" will list all files in the Assets/Scenes directory.

tool_schemas.name: directory_tree
tool_schemas.description: Returns a recursive directory tree for `path` (defaulting to the `Assets` root when empty), including nested files/directories up to `maxDepth` (with `-1` meaning unlimited). Results are returned as a single JSON tree and are not paged. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `path` is invalid or `maxDepth` is not a number, `NOT_FOUND` when the path does not exist, and `CONFLICT` when the path exists but is not a directory.

path.description: Path to the directory to get tree of. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder. Example: "Prefabs" will show the tree for Assets/Prefabs.

tool_schemas.name: search_files
tool_schemas.description: Recursively searches under `path` (defaulting to the `Assets` root when empty) for files and directories whose names match `pattern`, excluding any matches that also satisfy `excludePatterns`, and returns the full set of matches. Results are returned in one response and are not paged. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `pattern` is missing/empty or inputs are of the wrong type, `NOT_FOUND` when the starting `path` does not exist, and `CONFLICT` when the starting `path` exists but is not a directory.

path.description: Path to search from. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder. Example: "Scripts" will search within Assets/Scripts.

tool_schemas.name: get_file_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata for the file or directory at `path` (defaulting to the `Assets` root when empty), including whether it is a file or directory and other available stat-like attributes. This endpoint returns a single object and is not paged. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `path` is not a string or is malformed, and `NOT_FOUND` when no file or directory exists at the given path.

path.description: Path to the file to get info for. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder.

tool_schemas.name: find_assets_by_type
tool_schemas.description: Finds Unity assets of the requested `assetType` within `searchPath` (resolved under `Assets` when relative, or the `Assets` root when empty) and returns the matching asset entries discovered up to `maxDepth` (or unlimited when `-1`). Results are returned as a single list and are not paged. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `assetType` is missing/empty or `maxDepth` is not a number, `NOT_FOUND` when `searchPath` does not exist, and `CONFLICT` when `searchPath` exists but is not a directory.

searchPath.description: Directory to search in. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. An empty string will search the entire Assets folder.

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth to search. 1 means search only in the specified directory, 2 includes immediate subdirectories, and so on. Set to -1 for unlimited depth.

tool_schemas.name: list_unity_editor_sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists registered Unity Editor sessions visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status and other fields, ordered by updated_at descending; returns a paginated result. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to view sessions and VALIDATION_ERROR if filters or pagination parameters are invalid.

mcp_client_id.description: Filter sessions by MCP client identifier.

project_guid.description: Filter sessions by Unity project GUID.

connection_name.description: Filter sessions by connection name (exact match).

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_unity_editor_session
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single Unity Editor session by id. Returns the session record if found. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read sessions.

tool_schemas.name: update_unity_editor_session
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a Unity Editor session, including driving allowed lifecycle transitions via status. Returns the updated session record. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if an invalid transition is requested (e.g., terminated -> any), and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to modify sessions.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Must be a valid transition from the session's current status.

last_seen_scene_path.description: Last known active scene path for this session (informational).

tool_schemas.name: list_scene_snapshots
tool_schemas.description: Lists scene snapshots for a Unity Editor session (or for the current active session when session_id is omitted), optionally filtered by status and scene_path; returns a paginated result ordered by captured_at descending. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot view snapshots and VALIDATION_ERROR if filters or pagination parameters are invalid.

session_id.description: Unity Editor session id. If omitted, uses the currently connected session context.

scene_path.description: Filter snapshots by exact scene path.

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: update_scene_snapshot
tool_schemas.description: Updates a scene snapshot's lifecycle status (e.g., captured -> superseded/invalid). Returns the updated snapshot record. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the snapshot does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if the requested transition is not allowed, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to modify snapshots.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Must be a valid transition from the snapshot's current status.

metadata.description: This backend models a Unity MCP bridge that maintains registered Unity Editor connections, tracks project/scene snapshots, and provides a virtualized view of the Unity project's Assets filesystem.
